nodes.label: Selvarin
nodes.description: Female Web Weaver seer dragon. Crystal scales glitter; scale colour, body structure and size are not established.
nodes.creative_treatment: Genomskinliga opalfjäll med havsgrönt skimmer; hon väntar tills frågan är färdig.

nodes.label: Stillgrottan
nodes.description: Huge cave containing shadowy chambers. Source does not supply an architectural floor plan.
nodes.creative_treatment: Blågrön sten; kristallens svaga ljus visar djupet utan att möblera det.

nodes.label: Stillglaset
nodes.description: Very large, transparent, bubble-like crystal; Dhuaar meets within; crystal shields meeting participants' thoughts from interfering vibrational chatter in Conway's account.
nodes.creative_treatment: Nästan färglös volym med tunn opalgrön kant och inga införda troner.

nodes.label: Lyssnarrummen
nodes.description: Plural chambers collectively described as containing meditation seats, small shrines, counselor benches and thrones. No number of chambers or one-room-per-furnishing allocation supplied.
nodes.creative_treatment: Blågröna skuggor och varmt kopparljus; inget nytt rumsantal.

nodes.label: Det oskrivna rummet
nodes.description: An empty chamber to which Kaudra may send a student she judges ready and worthy for cleansing and opening of highest spiritual connections in Conway's system. Not Dream Chamber.
nodes.creative_treatment: Tomhet är formvalet; inga nya kar, ljusaltaren eller instrument.

nodes.label: Samklangsrådet
nodes.description: Discusses matters vital to Multiverse balance; specific members, number, seating and Kaudra membership not established.
nodes.source_label: Dhuaar — High Council of the Multiverse
nodes.creative_treatment: Lyssnande i centrum; inga nya fasta stolar eller ledare.

nodes.label: Gryningskristallens grotta
nodes.description: A crystal cave sacred site protected by Kaudra, near the gate to the Highest. Identity with the p43 huge cave remains unresolved.
nodes.source_label: Sacred crystal cave near the Highest gate
nodes.creative_treatment: Bleka opalytor i mörker; fristående referensbild.

nodes.label: Urtröskeln
nodes.description: Gate named only as a landmark near the sacred crystal cave in p42 context. No cave entrance, physical design or Kaudra gate-guarding role established here.
nodes.creative_treatment: En pärlljus rand utan visad genomfart.

nodes.label: Alla vägars trädgård
nodes.description: Garden enclosed by a high hedge; described as seemingly endless and representing many cultures. Shrines, temples, gazebos, flower-covered shelters, flowers, streams, waterfalls, fountains and small bridges over ponds; students from the Multiverse may be encountered. Placement inside cave NOT verified.
nodes.creative_treatment: Salviagrönt, mild ros och kalkljus kring broar och vatten.

nodes.label: Disporten
nodes.description: Misty gate that returns traveler to Upperworld near Kaudra according to p45. It is not Dream Chamber and does not specifically open into cave.
nodes.creative_treatment: Dimgrått med opalskiftning, ingen korridor ritas.

nodes.label: Trådporten
nodes.description: Gate with cobweb painting leading to the Web Weavers special side area. This route is not established as a direct cave entrance.
attributes: leads to Web Weaver side area

nodes.label: Vävsystrarna
nodes.description: Female seer dragons; Kaudra belongs to them, not established as their leader. Do not conflate with separate Star-Moon clan.
nodes.creative_treatment: Trådmönster mellan opal och blått; individerna får egna uttryck.

nodes.label: Försoningslyktan
nodes.realm: Otherworld sacred-site context; exact site unknown
nodes.description: Approved separate p43 sacred-site entry. Not demonstrated to be inside the huge cave or the Garden.
nodes.creative_treatment: Ett litet varmt ljus, utan ny fast byggnadsgeometri.

Visualize physical structures as abstract labels until source-specific detail and artistic decisions receive separate approval.

steps: sit upright in chair; back straight, feet flat on floor, hands in lap
take three slow deep breaths; progressively relax muscles
visualize brilliant white light with guardian spirits at your side
symbolically leave upsetting matters/people in well's darkness
walk away from well and leave disturbances behind
return to awareness of physical body
move fingers and feet slowly until comfortable again
modules.note: Printed walk-into-light instruction follows a specific light-cone scene; do not import that cone's architecture into other meditations.

steps: altar cloth on floor or ground with one side north
salt bowl to west/left; water bowl to east/right; altar stones before seated participant
kneel facing north; left hand above salt, right above water; invoke positive universal powers
stand and circle altar cloth clockwise, sprinkling salt in west-north-east-south order
repeat the directional circuit with water

printed_bounds.ends: before Dragons of the Elements section

steps: pour water into a potted plant or onto the ground
not_included: speech thanking the newly attracted co-magician dragon

scenes.realm: First Ring (named); exact Otherworld level not stated
facts: velvety darkness gives way to sunlight and huge wooden door with iron scrollwork/hinges
pull heavy chain attached to deep-sounding bell; door opens slowly
brightly coloured Gate dragon just inside doorway; door shuts behind visitor
circular First Ring is sensed but seen room is spacious, narrow, with slightly curved walls and skylights; ceiling unseen
endless tables, shelves of scrolls/books, wall diagrams/maps, open cabinets of herb jars and tall oil bottles
registry table beside closed door: quill in ink bottle and open book; student signs if certain
tiny silver dragon figure fastened to clothing; one question permitted
brilliant light cone rises endlessly from stone floor; guardian points visitor toward it
unknown: Gate dragon identity and exact colours

facts: stone courtyard of mighty castle without walls, dragons of differing sizes, apprentices from Earth and other worlds
blue ribbons on human Apprentices; guardian dragon nudges student, holds hand and supports introductions
older co-magicians lower heads to meet apprentice gaze; varied eye colours/shapes and eyelashes
telepathic communication and dragon humming; the Music of the Multiverse including fleeting discordant note
tables with juice and cakes; apprentices and dragons exchange greeting
long line of co-magicians with their apprentices in front; bright doorways appear and student enters one

scenes.realm: imagined journey over geographic Earth; no mapped Otherworld level specified
facts: rosy dawn; stone-paved courtyard of ancient castle, stone steps set into its outer wall
green-and-gold co-magician dragon, wings slightly spread, kneels; rider holds harness strap on shoulders between wings
invisible warm-air bubble; takeoff from castle wall using thermal currents
fields, tree-lined dirt road, canal with shrubs and river; bank left and travel southeast
Pacific Northwest toward Arizona/New Mexico, red rock, desert plateau, ancient cliff dwellings, Grand Canyon
Mississippi journey Gulf to Great Lakes and Earth's supposed energy-line vision, attributed to Conway
Great Wall of China approached while invisibility from human sight is narrated; further destinations user-chosen
return to castle; dragon asks what tools give spell power; lighted door appears in wall
scenes.outside_meditation: p.63 answer: power comes from within; tools have no power in themselves

facts: wide very long board balanced on top of golden pyramid fulcrum in otherwise dark place
brilliant white at one end, bright gray near centre, full darkness at opposite end
co-magician motions student above support and telepathically explains calm centre of Multiversal energy
movement and thoughts imagined to influence board; both extremes seem less powerful than centre
dragon reassures student and holds them astrally; slight slide toward dark side first, note sensations
return to centre and rest; then slight slide toward bright side, note sensations
return to centre, step down, reflect; dragon offers individualized interpretation
after marked ritual beginning drape blue Apprentice ribbon across shoulders, seated/kneeling facing north
quartz point at cloth centre pointing north; amethyst north, amber east, aventurine south, moss agate west
concentrate on qualities sought in a new co-magician rather than imagined appearance
personal guardian present; newly encountered co-magician has specific colour, may withhold name initially
co-magician-specific thanks to dragons, guardian and new companion; release excess power to Earth before marked ending
unknown: new co-magician exact colour/name before encounter

scenes.realm: great visualized cave; no named Otherworld level
facts: physical preparation: altar cloth, bowls of sea salt/water, altar stones, jewelry or belt buckle; Full Moon preferable
close eyes, relax, visualize solid walls of great cave and large flight of humming dragons
feel warmth and hear folded wings; candidate asks passage from Apprentice to Enchanter Ring
Aldram, ancient Keeper of the Book, received student's earlier Apprentice oath
both hands palms up; Aldram lays hands over them, light touch; asks Enchanter oath
rhymed oath pledges study, help not harm; verse imagery not materials list
jewelry/buckle selected: power hand (most-used), close fist, lift overhead; short spoken declaration
touch object to forehead centre and then heart; pledge confidentiality about Enchanter arts
sit quietly a few minutes before referenced ending
unknown: full oath transcription not included here
